test_title: PYST 91: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six colleagues Victor, Wendy, Xander, Yara, Zoe, and Aaron are sitting in a circle facing away from the center. Victor is sitting to the immediate right of Wendy. Yara is not sitting next to Victor. Zoe, who is sitting to the immediate left of Wendy, is also sitting to the immediate right of Aaron. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Xander and Wendy?
solution:
Given: Six colleagues Victor, Wendy, Xander, Yara, Zoe, and Aaron are sitting in a circle facing away from the center.

1) Victor is sitting to the immediate right of Wendy.

2) Zoe, who is sitting to the immediate left of Wendy, is also sitting to the immediate right of Aaron.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a8828f4bb0b0e4cb28ba5ea835d3d5f827a9ce2bb2dc4aace93f844da8b84b7.png] 

3) Yara is not sitting next to Victor. 

**Final arrangement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d2fda6379d532134a876a2ee095da920c394ca588892d5130f71f9caa96de38.png] 

So, **Victor **is the immediate neighbour of both Xander and Wendy.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Victor**".
